name: umd-canvas
description: Read-only UMD Canvas course mirror for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Read synchronized courses and learning materials.
interface.longDescription: A private, read-only connector to the homelab Canvas mirror. It follows instructor-curated module paths and exposes courses, assignments, announcements, pages, syllabi, and extracted document text without browser automation.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through the instructor-curated modules for a course.
Find the material I should study for my next assignment.
